newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Medallion cut near-term.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Medallion cut near-term.

text.p: - EVEREN Securities said Monday it cut its near-term rating on Medallion Financial Corp to market performer from outperformer. It left its long-term rating of outperformer unchanged.
- EVEREN said in a statement that it believes Medallion's stock has approached full valuation for the intermediate term and is therefore changing its rating.

- EVEREN said Medallion was awarded a 5-year contract to provide taxi-top advertising for 1,800 New York City cabs. Although the contract is seen benefitting Medallion, EVEREN said its earnings projections still assume the company has an additional 1,000 units under control by the end of 1997.
- EVEREN said its rating change was effective Friday, March 7.
